dialogue.text: She tends to keep personal info minimal.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text: Even her age is not of public knowledge,<d=0.25/> somehow.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
So I was surprised to know she's 43<d=0.5/>,
like<d=0.25/> twice my age!
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text: Maybe I overestimated how ancient people'd look in their fourties.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text: Makes you wonder what other secrets she's keeping...
dialogue.speaker: April
